context.passage:
Main Attraction Cinema, an innovative entertainment complex with venues across
New Mexico that offers customers dinner and a movie under one roof, is seeking to
fill the following positions at its Albuquerque location.
Night manager: Oversees operations, trains and manages statt, coordinates schedules,
addresses customer inquiries, and promotes a professional and courteous atmosphere.
At least two years of relevant experience is required.
Chef: Cooks a variety of dishes, ensuring quality and consistency. Collaborates with
kitchen staff to develop new recipes and seasonal menus. A culinary degree or
equivalent experience is required.
Projectionist: Operates and maintains projectors and ensures that movies start on
time and play without issues. Detail-oriented job seekers with a passion for film are
encouraged to apply. Will train the right candidate.
Floor employee: Sells tickets, seats attendees, works the concession stand, and cleans
auditoriums between films, among other tasks.
Main Attraction Cinema offers competitive pay, discounts on tickets and food, and
advancement opportunities. Visit www.mainattractioncinema.com/careers to apply.

choices: It has more than one location.
It hosts a seasonal film festival.
